text: BotCrew 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的群聊与桌面协作插件，将 WorkBuddy、千问办公和自定义成员放进同一工作区对话，并提供群聊页面、右侧工位面板及 MCP 工具。它通过 DSH 面板注入群聊和实时工作状态界面，并用本机服务连接 WorkBuddy 与千问办公。用户可以在不同会话中分派任务、查看和等待回复、管理别名与产物、调用千问 CLI，并登记人工审批。适合需要让多个桌面办公助手围绕同一任务协作的 DSH 用户。需要安装并登录 WorkBuddy 和千问办公；不需要为插件另配 API Key。

BotCrew brings WorkBuddy, QwenWork, and custom members into a DSH group chat with an embedded chat, status panel, and MCP tools. Users can assign tasks, follow replies, manage artifacts, and record approvals. WorkBuddy and QwenWork must be installed and signed in; no separate API key is needed.

BotCrew 的功能「群聊调度」：在 DSH 对话群聊中向 WorkBuddy、千问办公或自定义成员分派任务。可通过群聊消息和成员提及触发，任务与回复留在会话中。
BotCrew 的功能「任务跟踪」：可列出会话、选择或新建对话，发送或暂存消息，并等待任务完成、读取最后回复或停止生成。通过 MCP 的 office_* 工具调用。
BotCrew 的功能「工位状态面板」：在 DSH 右侧面板显示 WorkBuddy 与千问办公的标题、任务数量、连接状态和屏幕截图，页面会定时刷新。
BotCrew 的功能「审批记录」：助手可登记需要人工决定的问题和选项，之后记录人的决定，并在待审批列表中查看尚未处理的事项。

dsh-botcrew README · Introduction：

dsh-botcrew README · Introduction：**BotCrew** turns **WorkBuddy** and **千问办公** into members of one DSH group chat. You write one instruction, `@WorkBuddy` extracts the source material, `@千问办公` re-lays it out, and a reviewer checks the result — while a live panel shows both desks.

It is **local-first**: no cloud sandbox, no API keys for the office apps, no screen streaming. It drives the apps already signed in on your Mac or PC through Chromium DevTools Protocol, and exposes the same operations as `mcp__office__*` tools.

---

dsh-botcrew README · Why：Most agent tools stop at a chat box. Real office work already lives in desktop apps: a report in WorkBuddy, a deck in 千问, a PDF on disk, an approval in a group chat.

BotCrew connects those pieces:

dsh-botcrew README · Why：- **One place to command** — a group chat with members, `@` mentions and attachments.
- **Real executors** — WorkBuddy and 千问 are operated as apps, not reimplemented as prompts.
- **Work stays in the thread** — task state, files and answers sit next to the instruction instead of being copy-pasted.
- **Human approval stays human** — publishing, paying and deleting can be gated behind approval cards.

---

dsh-botcrew README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| 🧠 **Multi-agent group chat** | Chief, WorkBuddy, 千问办公 and custom members in one thread. |
| 🖥️ **Real desktop control** | WorkBuddy `:9331` and 千问 `:9444` over CDP; qoder CLI for custom members. |
| 🔁 **One thread, multiple agents** | Assign WorkBuddy, 千问办公 and reviewers in the same thread; outputs stay next to the task. |
| 🧑‍💻 **Custom members** | Name + role, executed for real by the qwen CLI. Up to 10 members. |
| 📎 **Files in / out** | Paste a path, drag a file, or upload; artifacts come back as cards. |
| 🛂 **Approvals** | `office_request_approval` / `office_resolve_approval`; pending items surface in the panel. |
| 📊 **Live work panel** | Side-by-side WorkBuddy and 千问 screenshots, current task, queue, artifacts. |
| 🔌 **MCP-native** | Every chat action is also a tool: `office_send`, `office_wait`, `office_artifacts`… |
| 🔒 **Local-only** | Panel binds `127.0.0.1`; no account passwords are stored. |

dsh-botcrew README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11 or macOS 13+** | Desktop automation is implemented for both platforms. |
| **DSH Desktop 0.2.1+** | Plugin host and Web UI. |
| **WorkBuddy 5.x** | Installed and signed in. |
| **QwenWork 1.4+** | Installed and signed in; `qoderclicn` available for CLI tasks. |
| **Node.js 22+** | The DSH bundled runtime is enough. |

mcp__office__*"] The plugin has three parts: - **Host plugin** — starts the local panel service. - **Client plugin** — group chat, member panel, `@` chips, attachments, right-side work panel. - **MCP server** — the same operations as tools, so an agent can drive the office apps without the UI. ---

plugin_manager install_bundle { "target": "C:/path/to/dsh-botcrew" }
```

dsh-botcrew README · From source：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/hankniu77/dsh-botcrew.git
cd dsh-botcrew
```

Then install the directory through `plugin_manager` as above (no build step; the package has no npm dependencies).

<sub>示意：检测到 WorkBuddy 未开调试端口、千问未运行、CLI 未登录。</sub>

dsh-botcrew README · First run: automatic setup：| State | What the plugin does |
|---|---|
| Installed, not running | **Starts it automatically** with the debug port. |
| Running, no debug port | Shows **Restart WorkBuddy / Restart 千问** — never silently kills an app with unsaved work. |
| 千问 CLI not logged in | Starts `qoderclicn login`, opens the browser authorization page, then polls. |
| Everything ready | Card closes automatically. |

The **环境** button in the header reopens the same checker at any time.

dsh-botcrew README · Members and permissions：- Add WorkBuddy / 千问 if they are not already in the group.
- Add a custom member with a **name** and **role**; it is executed by the qwen CLI.
- Each member has **读 / 写 / 命令 / 外发** switches.
- Removing a member with a running task asks **停止并移除 / 仅移除 / 取消**.
- At least one member must remain; the limit is 10.

dsh-botcrew README · Work panel：`http://127.0.0.1:8765` is a local, read-mostly view of both desks: current title, queue, debug port, screenshots, and pending approvals.

dsh-botcrew README · Configuration：Default config lives in the package (`config.json`); user overrides go to:

```text
~/.dsh/botcrew/data/config.json
```

```json
{
  "port": 9331,
  "panelPort": 8765,
  "workbuddyExe": "C:/Program Files/WorkBuddy/WorkBuddy.exe",

dsh-botcrew README · Configuration：| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `port` | WorkBuddy CDP port, default `9331`. |
| `panelPort` | Local panel port, default `8765`. |
| `workbuddyExe` | Path to the WorkBuddy executable; auto-detected on Windows and macOS. |
| `qwen.exe` | Path to the QwenWork executable; auto-detected on Windows and macOS. |
| `qwen.cli` | Path to `qoderclicn` (`.exe` on Windows); auto-detected. |
| `qwen.gitBashPath` | Git Bash used by the qwen CLI on Windows. |
| `home` | Data directory, default `~/.dsh/botcrew/data`. |

dsh-botcrew README · Configuration：Environment override: `BOTCREW_CONFIG=/path/to/config.json` (legacy `OFFICE_BUS_CONFIG` is also accepted).

dsh-botcrew README · Security model：- **Local only.** The panel listens on `127.0.0.1`; there is no cloud relay.
- **No credentials.** BotCrew uses the apps you are already signed into; it does not read passwords.
- **Explicit restarts.** Apps running without a debug port are never killed silently.
- **Approvals for side effects.** Publishing, paying and deleting should be gated with an approval card.
- **Permission switches are best-effort.** Custom members can be restricted through read/write/command/external switches and the qwen permission mode; for WorkBuddy and 千问 the restriction is a task-level instruction, not a hard sandbox.

dsh-botcrew README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| WorkBuddy port `9331` not reachable | Open **环境** → **重启 WorkBuddy**, or launch it with the debug port. |
| 千问 port `9444` not reachable | Open **环境** → **重启千问办公**. |
| 千问 CLI not logged in | Open **环境** → **打开千问登录**, finish the browser flow. |
| Panel page does not load | Check `http://127.0.0.1:8765`; another process may own the port. |
| Workspace row missing after DSH upgrade | Reinstall/update the plugin; the row is injected into the session tree. |
| `@WorkBuddy` sends nothing | Confirm WorkBuddy is on the target conversation and the debug port is open. |

dsh-botcrew README · Publishing：1. Bump `version` and add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
2. `npm pack` and attach the tarball to a GitHub Release (`gh release create vX.Y.Z botcrew.tgz`).
3. Update the registry entry at [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) with the release `tarball:` URL.
4. Optional: publish to npm; if the package name changes, update `lib/client.js` loader id and `cordis.patch.yml` paths.
